name: Rocketeer
flavour: One rocket at a time. There is always one.
art_prompt: a burly thug with smooth deep blue skin and orcish features: a heavy jutting jaw with two small tusks, a flat wide nose, small angry yellow eyes under a heavy brow, pointed ears, a shaved head, wearing bright red work overalls over a bare muscular chest and heavy boots, a big rusty steel rocket launcher tube braced on one shoulder loaded with a bright red rocket, crouching to aim, snarling
motion: dancing on the spot: a cocky shuffling victory dance, hips swinging side to side, one fist pumping in the air, knees bobbing, the launcher rocking on the shoulder
back_hint: seen from behind: the launcher tube on the shoulder with the red rocket's fins showing at the back, the red overalls' straps crossing the bare blue back, no face
dead_hint: lying dead on its back on the sand, the launcher tube dropped beside it, the red overalls dusty, arms and legs sprawled, tusked jaw slack
doc: Sits down far off and fires a slow bright-red rocket that hunts you and cannot be shot down; the moment it is gone (it hit, or it burnt out) he reloads and fires the next, so one of his is always in the air. The blast throws you hard off your feet and throws every creature near it clear. Kill him and his rocket goes wild. A special: specials come on their own clock from 2:30, one at a time (a rocketeer or, from stage 2, a harpooner), the next 45 to 60 seconds after the last one dies.
